## What Needs Improvement?

Which page, section, or instruction needs to be changed?

**Documentation Location:** Link to the relevant file, page, or section.

## What's the Problem?

- [ ] Instructions are unclear
- [ ] Information is incorrect or outdated
- [ ] A step is missing
- [ ] Installation or setup instructions are incomplete
- [ ] An error message is not explained
- [ ] Something else

Explain the problem in more detail.

## Suggested Improvement

How could the documentation be made clearer or more useful?

If possible, include corrected wording or an example.

## Who Is Affected?

- [ ] Windows users
- [ ] Linux users
- [ ] iPhone / iOS users
- [ ] Contributors / developers
- [ ] All users

## Additional Context

Include screenshots, relevant links, or examples if they help explain the issue.

## Checklist

- [ ] I checked whether the documentation issue has already been reported.
- [ ] I identified the affected documentation, if possible.
